Sanfrancisco ship yard class

HISTORY: The yard where the original enterprise (not the NX-01 the original NCC :P) was built and refited.

This is not a mod for armada 2 just a model!

there is a build button This model has ~1000 polys!

This zip file contains the safrancisco yard, two textures (High and low) with alpha channel.

There is only high res and low res included-remove low from low res texture and put into rgb to get working!

There is a build button!

if u want a new wireframe you will have to do it your self as i have not got the foggiest!   

There is a odf; YOU WILL NEED MODDING EXPERIENCE TO GET THIS IN GAME!

sod in sod directory
odf in odf station directory
tga in textures/rgb

If you wish to use this model in your own mod you can! there would be little point in me making it otherwise! 

All the modeling credits go to captain fingers (err thats me)

texture by me, a schematic and a render of Liam 'Cyberbob' Williams starship yard.
